description: This file defines the LoggerDefaultRenderer class, which extends LoggerObjectRenderer and provides a default implementation for rendering objects by type casting using var_export. It is part of the log4php logging framework, specifically in the 'or' subpackage.

classes.name: LoggerDefaultRenderer
classes.description: A class providing a default object rendering strategy in the log4php framework, rendering objects using var_export.

methods.name: LoggerDefaultRenderer
methods.description: Constructor method for LoggerDefaultRenderer class. It does not perform any initialization.

methods.name: doRender
methods.description: Renders an object by type casting it through var_export, returning the resulting string.
